(rule!
  (let* ((items (sort (map (lambda (obj)
                             (let* ((sub0 (subgrid g (obj-r1 obj) (obj-c1 obj) (obj-r2 obj) (obj-c2 obj)))
                                    (sub (if (> (rows sub0) (cols sub0)) (rotate-cw sub0) sub0))
                                    (per (* 2 (+ (rows sub) (cols sub)))))
                               (list per (obj-r1 obj) (obj-c1 obj) sub)))
                           (objects g 0))
                      (lambda (a b)
                        (if (= (first a) (first b))
                            (if (= (second a) (second b))
                                (< (third a) (third b))
                                (< (second a) (second b)))
                            (> (first a) (first b))))))
         (shapes (map fourth items))
         (out-h (+ (apply + (map rows shapes)) (max 0 (- (length shapes) 1))))
         (out-w (apply max (map cols shapes))))
    (let pack ([remaining shapes] [top 0] [out (empty-grid out-h out-w 0)])
      (if (empty? remaining)
          out
          (let* ((shape (first remaining))
                 (next (for*/fold ([acc out])
                                   ([r (in-range (rows shape))]
                                    [c (in-range (cols shape))])
                         (let ((v (at shape r c)))
                           (if (not (= v 0)) (set-cell acc (+ top r) c v) acc)))))
            (pack (rest remaining) (+ top (rows shape) 1) next))))))

(rule!
  ;; Crop same-color objects and orient tall crops clockwise.
  ;; Rank by normalized_top_edge; ties use original source position.
  ;; Stack the normalized crops left-aligned with one zero row between them.
  ;; Variant/rival: intended.
  (lambda (g)
    (let* ((items
            (sort
              (map (lambda (obj)
                     (let* ((raw (subgrid g (obj-r1 obj) (obj-c1 obj) (obj-r2 obj) (obj-c2 obj)))
                            (sub (if (> (rows raw) (cols raw)) (rotate-cw raw) raw))
                            (score (count-if (lambda (v) (not (= v 0))) (first sub))))
                       (list score (obj-r1 obj) (obj-c1 obj) sub)))
                   (objects g 0))
              (lambda (a b) (if (= (first a) (first b))
                     (if (= (second a) (second b))
                         (< (third a) (third b))
                         (< (second a) (second b)))
                     (> (first a) (first b))))))
           (shapes (map fourth items))
           (out-h (+ (apply + (map rows shapes)) (- (length shapes) 1)))
           (out-w (apply max (map cols shapes))))
      (let pack ((remaining shapes) (top 0) (out (empty-grid out-h out-w 0)))
        (if (empty? remaining)
            out
            (let* ((shape (first remaining))
                   (next (for*/fold ((acc out))
                                   ((r (in-range (rows shape))) (c (in-range (cols shape))))
                           (let ((value (at shape r c)))
                             (if (= value 0) acc (set-cell acc (+ top r) c value))))))
              (pack (rest remaining) (+ top (rows shape) 1) next)))))))
